rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy doc carries strategy, not structure
rules_evaluated.evidence: Re-read at current wording per the drift trigger. Three places the private doc restates (rather than points at) this file's content, and the restated copy has since rotted against dated, Antti-directed rewrites the file's own maintainer/backing blocks record: (1) doc's M6-detail 'quick framing' example quotes '...Practitioners call them judges when LLM-based, verifiers when deterministic, gates when placed in CI...' — a survey-verb construction the file's own Stance ledger explicitly rejected ('decided: judge / verifier / gate is stated as a definition, not a survey, 2026-08-01… Do not restore a survey verb ("Practitioners say…")', backing L142); (2) doc's Scheduled-agents paragraph says the student leaves 'knowing… when it fits (standing verifier runs, nightly codebase sweeps, rule-drift monitoring)' — the current body no longer names any of those three examples, having been replaced 2026-09-03 (maintainer Watch-for note L103, backing claim `loop-squashes-then-cracks-harder` L113) with 'the loop squashes the recurring things… cracks harder work' (L34); (3) doc's M6-detail intro asserts '`composing-the-workflow.md` places checks and stop conditions at workflow seams' — the current workflow definition (L48-51) was rewritten 2026-09-05, same-day as this read, to explicitly exclude checks from the definition (backing claim `workflow-is-skills-composed-around-one-task` L120: "Antti's definition 2026-09-05: composition and per-step instructions, checks are not part of it"), so the doc's own summary of what this file teaches is now the opposite of what it teaches.
